68700.commentary: (ANa) sammā nibbindamāno'ti-ādīsu pana sammā hetunā nayena nibbid'ānupassanāya nibbindanto ukkaṇṭhanto, virāg'ānupassanāya virajjanto, paṭisaṅkh'ānupassanāya muccanassa upāyaṃ katvā vimuccamāno, adhimokkhavasena vā vimuccamāno sanniṭṭhānaṃ kurumāno'ti attho.

examples.text: sabbe sattā āhāraṭṭhitikā, imasmiṃ kho, bhikkhave, ekadhamme bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī samma'd'atthaṃ abhisamecca diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hoti.

68701.meaning1: became free; was released; was liberated (from)

examples.text: idam'avoca bhagavā. attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandun'ti. imasmiṃ ca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne saṭṭhimattānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsū'ti.
tāva'd'eva anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucci

68702.grammar: inf of vimuccati, pass, intrans (+abl or +loc)
68702.meaning1: to become free; to be released; to be liberated (from)

examples.text: yāvañ'c'idaṃ, bhikkhave, alam'eva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ alaṃ virajjituṃ alaṃ vimuccitun'ti.
yañ'ca kho etaṃ, bhikkhave, vuccati cittaṃ iti'pi, mano iti'pi, viññāṇaṃ iti'pi, tatr'āssutavā puthujjano n'ālaṃ nibbindituṃ n'ālaṃ virajjituṃ n'ālaṃ vimuccituṃ.

68704.commentary: (SNa) ettha loko vimucchito'ti etesu chasu ārammaṇesu loko adhimucchito.

examples.text: rūpā saddā rasā gandhā, phassā dhammā ca kevalā, etaṃ lok'āmisaṃ ghoraṃ, ettha loko vimucchito.

68710.commentary: (NIDD1) vimutto'ti mutto vimutto parimutto suvimutto accanta-anupādāvimokkhena. (MNa) vimuttasmiṃ vimuttam'iti ñāṇan'ti iminā paccavekkhaṇañāṇaṃ dasseti.

examples.text: evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako… viññāṇasmiṃ nibbindati, nibbidā virajjati, virāgā vimuccati, vimuttasmiṃ vimuttam'iti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
accī yathā vātavegena khittā, atthaṃ paleti na upeti saṅkhaṃ, evaṃ munī nāmakāyā vimutto, atthaṃ paleti na upeti saṅkhaṃ.
katamāni cattāri? sīl'aggaṃ, samādhi'ggaṃ, paññā'ggaṃ, vimutt'aggaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri aggānī'ti. catutthaṃ.

68712.meaning1: with liberated mind; with emancipated heart

examples.text: yo idha caraṇesu pattipatto, kusalo sabbadā ājānāti dhammaṃ, sabbattha na sajjati vimuttacitto, paṭighā yassa na santi caraṇavā so.
evaṃ vimuttacitto kho, aggivessana, bhikkhu na kenaci saṃvadati, na kenaci vivadati, yañ'ca loke vuttaṃ tena voharati, aparāmasan'ti.

68713.meaning1: fact of having a liberated mind; fact of having an emancipated heart

examples.text: vimuttacittattā khv'āhaṃ, sāriputta, mahāpuriso'ti vadāmi. avimuttacittattā no mahāpuriso'ti vadāmi.

68714.meaning1: fact of liberation; state of emancipation (from)

examples.text: yāyaṃ, bhante ānanda, samādhi na c'ābhinato na c'āpanato na ca sasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagato, vimuttattā ṭhito, ṭhitattā santusito, santusitattā no paritassati. ayaṃ, bhante ānanda, samādhi kiṃphalo vutto bhagavatā'ti?
tadappatiṭṭhitaṃ viññāṇaṃ avirūḷhaṃ anabhisaṅkhacca vimuttaṃ. vimuttattā ṭhitaṃ. ṭhitattā santusitaṃ. santusitattā na paritassati. aparitassaṃ paccattaññ'eva parinibbāyati.

68715.meaning1: fact of being without; fact of being free (from)

examples.text: cattāro ariyamaggā sayaṃ samucchinnehi kilesehi vimuttattā samucchedavimuttī'ti saṅkhyaṃ gacchan'ti. cattāri sāmaññaphalāni magg'ānubhāvena kilesānaṃ paṭippassaddh'ante uppannattā paṭippassaddhivimuttī'ti saṅkhyaṃ gacchan'ti.
virāgo pana, bhante, kim'atthiyo'ti? virāgo kho, rādha, vimutt'attho. vimutti pana, bhante, kim'atthiyā'ti?

68717.meaning1: one's freedom from; oneself as free from

examples.text: tassa sabbehi imehi pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehi visuddham'attānaṃ samanupassato vimuttam'attānaṃ samanupassato pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.

68718.meaning1: mentally liberated; with emancipated mind; with free mind

examples.text: muñca pure muñca pacchato, majjhe muñca bhavassa pāragū, sabbattha vimuttamānaso, na punaṃ jātijaraṃ upehisi.
āvilacitto anāvilaṃ, sarajo vītarajaṃ anaṅgaṇaṃ, sabbattha vimuttamānasaṃ, kiṃ maṃ ovariyāna tiṭṭhasi.

68719.meaning1: excellency of liberation; best kind of release

examples.text: evaṃ vimuttacitto kho, aggivessana, bhikkhu tīhi anuttariyehi samannāgato hoti, dassan'ānuttariyena, paṭipad'ānuttariyena, vimutt'ānuttariyena.

68720.meaning1: base for deliverance; reason for release; cause for liberation

examples.text: tassa atthapaṭisaṃvedino dhammapaṭisaṃvedino pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. idaṃ paṭhamaṃ vimutt'āyatanaṃ.

68722.meaning1: hope of release; expectation of liberation

examples.text: taṃ kissa hetu? yā hi'ssa, bhikkhave, pubbe avimuttassa vimutt'āsā sā paṭippassaddhā. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, puggalo vigat'āso.
tato aññā vimuttassa, ñāṇaṃ ve hoti tādino, akuppā me vimuttī'ti, bhavasaṃyojanakkhayā.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, mahāsamuddo ekaraso loṇaraso, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ayaṃ dhammavinayo ekaraso vimuttiraso

68724.meaning1: talk on liberation; discussion about release

examples.text: seyyath'idaṃ, appicchakathā santuṭṭhikathā pavivekakathā asaṃsaggakathā vīriy'ārambhakathā sīlakathā samādhikathā paññākathā vimuttikathā vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā

asekkhena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato hoti, asekkhena samādhikkhandhena samannāgato hoti, asekkhena paññākkhandhena samannāgato hoti, asekkhena vimuttikkhandhena samannāgato hoti, asekkhena vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandhena samannāgato hoti.

68726.meaning1: total understanding of emancipation; knowing and seeing of release; understanding and insight into liberation

examples.text: ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū sīlasampannā samādhisampannā ñāṇasampannā vimuttisampannā vimuttiñāṇadassanasampannā, dassanam'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bahukāraṃ vadāmi

appicchakathā, santuṭṭhikathā, pavivekakathā, asaṃsaggakathā, vīriy'ārambhakathā, sīlakathā, samādhikathā, paññākathā, vimuttikathā, vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā'ti, imāni kho, bhikkhave, dasa kathāvatthūni.

68727.meaning1: talk about understanding and insight into liberation

examples.text: seyyath'idaṃ, appicchakathā santuṭṭhikathā pavivekakathā asaṃsaggakathā vīriy'ārambhakathā sīlakathā samādhikathā paññākathā vimuttikathā vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā

68728.meaning1: aggregate of knowledge and vision of liberation

examples.text: aparipuṇṇassa kho vimuttiñāṇadassana-kkhandhassa pāripūriyā aññaṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya vihareyyaṃ.

68729.meaning1: for the purpose of total understanding of emancipation; for the sake of knowing and seeing of release; for the purpose of understanding and insight into liberation

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, nibbidāvirāgo vimuttiñāṇadassan'attho vimuttiñāṇadassan'ānisaṃso, yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ nibbidāvirāg'atthaṃ nibbidāvirāg'ānisaṃsaṃ

68730.meaning1: attainment of understanding and insight into liberation; success in knowing and seeing release

examples.text: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno vimuttiñāṇadassanasampadākathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā

idh'āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhu… attanā ca vimuttisampanno hoti vimuttisampadāya ca vaṇṇavādī, attanā ca vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanasampadāya ca vaṇṇavādī. evarūpena kho, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhunā gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyyā'ti.

68731.meaning1: talk of the attainment of knowledge and insight into liberation; discussion about success in knowing and seeing release

examples.text: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno vimuttiñāṇadassanasampadākathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā

68732.meaning1: accomplished in the knowledge and vision of liberation

examples.text: ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū sīlasampannā samādhisampannā ñāṇasampannā vimuttisampannā vimuttiñāṇadassanasampannā, dassanam'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bahukāraṃ vadāmi
ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno vimutti-ñāṇadassana-sampadā-kathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā

68733.meaning1: more accomplished in the knowledge and vision of liberation (than)
68733.commentary: (SNa) sīlasampannataran'ti sīlena sampannataraṃ, adhikataran'ti attho. sesesu'pi es'eva nayo. ettha ca sīl'ādayo cattāro dhammā lokiyalok'uttarā kathitā, vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ lokiyam'eva. paccavekkhaṇañāṇaṃ h'etaṃ.

examples.text: na kho pan'āhaṃ passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya attanā vimuttiñāṇadassanasampannataraṃ aññaṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā, yam'ahaṃ sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya vihareyyaṃ.

68734.meaning1: for the benefit of total understanding of emancipation; for the advantage of knowing and seeing of release; for the good of knowledge and insight into liberation

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, nibbidāvirāgo vimuttiñāṇadassan'attho vimuttiñāṇadassan'ānisaṃso, yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ nibbidāvirāg'atthaṃ nibbidāvirāg'ānisaṃsaṃ

68735.meaning1: with freedom as the fifth; including liberation as the fifth

examples.text: so iminā vimuttipañcamena dhammena samannāgato yassaṃ yassaṃ disāyaṃ viharati vimuttacitto'va viharati. taṃ kissa hetu?

68737.meaning1: ripening in liberation; maturing in release

examples.text: atha kho bhagavato rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi, paripakkā kho rāhulassa vimuttiparipācaniyā dhammā, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ rāhulaṃ uttariṃ āsavānaṃ khaye vineyyanti.

68738.meaning1: ripening in liberation; maturing in release

examples.text: pañca vimuttiparipācanīyā saññā, aniccasaññā, anicce dukkhasaññā, dukkhe anattasaññā, pahānasaññā, virāgasaññā.
so rajanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ virājetvā, vimocanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ vimocetvā sammāvimuttiṃ phusati. ayaṃ vuccati, byagghapajjā, vimuttipārisuddhi.

68740.meaning1: factor related to striving for the purification of liberation

examples.text: iti evarūpiṃ vimuttipārisuddhiṃ aparipūraṃ vā paripūressāmi paripūraṃ vā tattha tattha paññāya anuggahessāmī'ti, yo tattha chando ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhī ca appaṭivānī ca sati ca sampajaññañ'ca, idaṃ vuccati, byagghapajjā, vimuttipārisuddhi-padhāniy'aṅgaṃ.

68741.meaning1: having the flavour of freedom; with the taste of liberation; with the essence of emancipation
68741.commentary: (UDa) vimuttiraso'ti kilesehi vimuccanaraso. sabbā hi sāsanassa sampatti yāva'd'eva anupādāya āsavehi cittassa vimuttiyā hoti.

examples.text: evam'evaṃ kho pahārāda ayaṃ dhammavinayo ekaraso vimuttiraso

68742.meaning1: attainment of liberation; success in emancipation

examples.text: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca vimuttisampanno vimuttisampadākathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā

idh'āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhu… attanā ca vimuttisampanno hoti vimuttisampadāya ca vaṇṇavādī, attanā ca vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanasampadāya ca vaṇṇavādī. evarūpena kho, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhunā gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyyā'ti.

68743.meaning1: talk of the attainment of liberation; discussion about success in emancipation

examples.text: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca vimuttisampanno vimuttisampadākathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā

68744.meaning1: skilled in liberation; accomplished in emancipation
68744.commentary: (MNt) vimuttī'ti ariyaphalan'ti vuttaṃ, vimuttisampanno'ti vuttattā. tañ'hi nipphādan'aṭṭhena sampādetabbaṃ, na nibbānan'ti.

examples.text: ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū sīlasampannā samādhisampannā ñāṇasampannā vimuttisampannā vimuttiñāṇadassanasampannā, dassanam'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bahukāraṃ vadāmi
ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca vimuttisampanno vimuttisampadākathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā

68745.meaning1: more skilled in liberation; more accomplished in emancipation (than)
68745.commentary: (SNa) sīlasampannataran'ti sīlena sampannataraṃ, adhikataran'ti attho. sesesu'pi es'eva nayo. ettha ca sīl'ādayo cattāro dhammā lokiyalok'uttarā kathitā, vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ lokiyam'eva. paccavekkhaṇañāṇaṃ h'etaṃ.

examples.text: na kho pan'āhaṃ passāmi sadevake … attanā vimuttisampannataraṃ aññaṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā, yam'ahaṃ sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya vihareyyaṃ.

68746.meaning1: centred in liberation; having liberation as essence; with release at the core

examples.text: te pana, samiddhi, kiṃadhipateyyā'ti? sat'ādhipateyyā, bhante'ti. te pana, samiddhi, kiṃuttarā'ti? paññ'uttarā, bhante'ti. te pana, samiddhi, kiṃsārā'ti? vimuttisārā, bhante'ti. te pana, samiddhi, kiṃogadhā'ti? amat'ogadhā, bhante'ti.
samādhippamukhā sabbe dhammā, sat'ādhipateyyā sabbe dhammā, paññ'uttarā sabbe dhammā, vimuttisārā sabbe dhammā, amat'ogadhā sabbe dhammā, nibbānapariyosānā sabbe dhammā'ti.
katame cattāro? sīlasāro, samādhisāro, paññāsāro, vimuttisāro, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro sārā'ti.

68748.meaning1: comfort of liberation; ease of emancipation
68748.commentary: (SNa) vimuttisukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedī'ti evaṃ arahattaṃ patvā vimuttisukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedento.

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā aṅgulimālo rahogato paṭisallīno vimuttisukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedi, tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi.
sabbaṃ niruttipathapāragataṃ sabuddhaṃ, buddhaṃ tilokatilakaṃ hatapāpadhammaṃ, dhammaṃ vimuttisukhadaṃ vihat'āghasaṃghaṃ, saṃghaṃ ca niccam'abhivandiya dakkhiṇeyyaṃ.
atha kho bhagavā bodhirukkhamūle satt'āhaṃ ekapallaṅkena nisīdi vimuttisukhapaṭisaṃvedī.

68751.meaning1: who professes a doctrine of deliverance; who teaches liberation
68751.meaning2: who profess a doctrine of deliverance; who teaches liberation

examples.text: santi, kassapa, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā vimuttivādā. te anekapariyāyena vimuttiyā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti.

kaṅkhāvitaraṇavisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, magg'āmaggañāṇadassana, visuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, paṭipadāñāṇadassanavisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, ñāṇadassanavisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, paññāvisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, vimuttivisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ.

68753.meaning1: who is liberated; who is free (in)

examples.text: etam'ādīnavaṃ ñatvā, dukkhaṃ ārambhapaccayā, sabb'ārambhaṃ paṭinissajja, anārambhe vimuttino.

iti kho, bhikkhave, avijj'ūpanisā saṅkhārā, saṅkhār'ūpanisaṃ viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇ'ūpanisaṃ nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūp'ūpanisaṃ saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatan'ūpaniso phasso, phass'ūpanisā vedanā, vedan'ūpanisā taṇhā, taṇh'ūpanisaṃ upādānaṃ, upādān'ūpaniso bhavo, bhav'ūpanisā jāti, jāt'ūpanisaṃ dukkhaṃ, dukkh'ūpanisā saddhā, saddh'ūpanisaṃ pāmojjaṃ, pāmojj'ūpanisā pīti, pīt'ūpanisā passaddhi, passaddh'ūpanisaṃ sukhaṃ, sukh'ūpaniso samādhi, samādh'ūpanisaṃ yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassan'ūpanisā nibbidā, nibbid'ūpaniso virāgo, virāg'ūpanisā vimutti, vimutt'ūpanisaṃ khayeñāṇaṃ.

68755.meaning1: I am freed; I am liberated; I am emancipated

examples.text: aññassa bhagavā buddho, dhammaṃ desesi cakkhumā, dhamme desiyamānamhi, sotam'odhesim'atthiko, taṃ me amoghaṃ savanaṃ, vimutto'mhi anāsavo.

68756.commentary: (ANa) vimokkho hoti cetaso'ti cittassa vimutti vimuccanā appavattibhāvo hoti. taṇhākkhayavimuttino hi khīṇ'āsavassa carimakaviññāṇanirodhena parinibbānaṃ viya cetaso vimokkho hoti, na gataṭṭhānaṃ paññāyati, apaṇṇattikabhāvūpagamo'y'eva hotī'ti attho.

examples.text: viññāṇassa nirodhena, taṇhākkhayavimuttino, pajjotass'eva nibbānaṃ, vimokkho hoti cetaso'ti.
yasmiṃ kāmā na vasanti, taṇhā yassa na vijjati, kathaṃkathā ca yo tiṇṇo, vimokkho tassa n'āparo.
yo mahāmeruno kūṭaṃ, vimokkhena aphassayi, vanaṃ pubbavidehānaṃ, ye ca bhūmisayā narā.

68763.meaning1: should be liberated; should be freed; should be emancipated
68763.commentary: (ANa) vimocanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ vimocetī'ti yehi ārammaṇehi cittaṃ vimocetabbaṃ, tesu yathā vimuccati, evaṃ karoti.

examples.text: sa kho so, byagghapajjā, ariyasāvako iminā ca sīlapārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgena samannāgato iminā ca cittapārisuddhi-padhāniy'aṅgena samannāgato iminā ca diṭṭhipārisuddhi-padhāniy'aṅgena samannāgato rajanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ virājeti, vimocanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ vimoceti.

68764.commentary: (VISM) vimocayaṃ cittan'ti paṭhamajjhānena nīvaraṇehi cittaṃ mocento vimocento, dutiyena vitakkavicārehi, tatiyena pītiyā, catutthena sukhadukkhehi cittaṃ mocento vimocento.

examples.text: vimocayaṃ cittaṃ assasissāmī'ti sikkhati, vimocayaṃ cittaṃ passasissāmī'ti sikkhati.

68767.commentary: (ANa) vimocanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ vimocetī'ti yehi ārammaṇehi cittaṃ vimocetabbaṃ, tesu yathā vimuccati, evaṃ karoti.

examples.text: sa kho so, byagghapajjā, ariyasāvako iminā ca sīlapārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgena samannāgato iminā ca cittapārisuddhi-padhāniy'aṅgena samannāgato iminā ca diṭṭhipārisuddhi-padhāniy'aṅgena samannāgato rajanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ virājeti, vimocanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ vimoceti.

68768.meaning1: having emancipated; having liberated; having set free

examples.text: so rajanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ virājetvā, vimocanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ vimocetvā sammāvimuttiṃ phusati. ayaṃ vuccati, byagghapajjā, vimuttipārisuddhi.

68773.meaning2: having deluded, having bewildered, having beguiled

68775.meaning2: having loitered; having tarried; having hung about

68782.commentary: (DNt) vimhāpayantī'ti aho acchariyapuriso'ti attani paresaṃ vimhayaṃ uppādenti.

68787.commentary: (APAa) disv'āhaṃ vimhitāsayo'ti evarūpaṃ bhayānakaṃ himavantaṃ kathaṃ sampatto'ti vimhita-ajjhāsayo acchariyabbhutacitto'ti attho.

examples.text: n'ekapāṇa-sahassānaṃ, taṃ viditvā'ti-vimhito, abhippasanno me yakkho, bhamitvāna giribbajaṃ.
saṅkappehi pareto so, kapaṇo viya jhāyati, sutvā paresaṃ nigghosaṃ, maṅku hoti tathāvidho.
manujassa pamattacārino, taṇhā vaḍḍhati māluvā viya, so plavatī hurā huraṃ, phalam'icchaṃ'va vanasmi vānaro.

68789.meaning1: distinctive mark; characteristic appearance; feature; (comm) accessories and implements

examples.text: na vaṇṇarūpena naro sujāno, na vissase ittaradassanena, susaññatānañ'hi viyañjanena, asaññatā lokam'imaṃ caranti.
chando nidānaṃ gāthānaṃ, akkharā tāsaṃ viyañjanaṃ, nāmasannissitā gāthā, kavi gāthānam'āsayo'ti.

68790.commentary: (SNa) viyañjanan'ti jananaṃ. akkharaṃ hi padaṃ janeti, padaṃ gāthaṃ janeti, gāthā atthaṃ pakāsetī'ti.

examples.text: kiṃsu nidānaṃ gāthānaṃ, kiṃsu tāsaṃ viyañjanaṃ, kiṃsu sannissitā gāthā, kiṃsu gāthānam'āsayo'ti
chando nidānaṃ gāthānaṃ, akkharā tāsaṃ viyañjanaṃ, nāmasannissitā gāthā, kavi gāthānam'āsayo'ti.

68791.meaning1: experienced; learned; initiated; (comm) distinguished in understanding

examples.text: dvīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito viyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ bahuñ'ca puññaṃ pasavati.
na tāv'āhaṃ, pāpima, parinibbāyissāmi, yāva me bhikkhuniyo na sāvikā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā bahussutā dhammadharā dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipannā
attaṃ pahāya anupādiyāno, ñāṇe'pi so nissayaṃ no karoti, sa ve viyattesu na vaggasārī, diṭṭhim'pi so na pacceti kiñci.

68794.commentary: (NIDD2) sādhu viyākarohī'ti taṃ sādhu ācikkhāhi desehi paññapehi paṭṭhapehi vivarāhi vibhajāhi uttānīkarohi pakāsehī'ti, taṃ me munī sādhu viyākarohi.

examples.text: yaṃ taṃ apucchimha akittayī no, aññaṃ taṃ pucchāma tadiṅgha brūhi, kathaṃ nu dhīrā vitaranti oghaṃ, jātiṃ jaraṃ sokapariddavañ'ca, taṃ me muni sādhu viyākarohi, tathā hi te vidito esa dhammo.
atthaṅ'gato so uda vā so n'atthi, udāhu ve sassatiyā arogo, taṃ me munī sādhu viyākarohi, tathā hi te vidito esa dhammo.

68795.meaning1: they explained; they defined; they described
68795.meaning2: they answered; they explained; they declared
68795.commentary: (NIDD2) ye me pubbe viyākaṃsū'ti. ye'ti yo ca bāvarī brāhmaṇo ye c'aññe tassa ācariyā, te sakaṃ diṭṭhiṃ sakaṃ khantiṃ sakaṃ ruciṃ sakaṃ laddhiṃ sakaṃ ajjhāsayaṃ sakaṃ adhippāyaṃ byākaṃsu ācikkhiṃsu desayiṃsu paññapiṃsu paṭṭhapiṃsu vivariṃsu vibhajiṃsu uttānīakaṃsu pakāsesunti, ye me pubbe viyākaṃsu.

examples.text: ye me pubbe viyākaṃsu, huraṃ gotamasāsanā, icc'āsi iti bhavissati, sabbaṃ taṃ itihītihaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ takkavaḍḍhanaṃ, n'āhaṃ tattha abhiramiṃ.
ye me pubbe viyākaṃsu, huraṃ gotamasāsanā, icc'āsi iti bhavissati, sabbaṃ taṃ itih'ītihaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ takkavaḍḍhanaṃ, n'āhaṃ tattha abhiramiṃ.
yo vejayantapāsāde, sakkaṃ so paripucchati, api āvuso jānāsi, taṇhakkhayavimuttiyo, tassa sakko viyākāsi, pañhaṃ puṭṭho yathātathaṃ.

68797.meaning1: explains in detail; describes in full

examples.text: nirāsaso so uda āsasāno, paññāṇavā so uda paññakappī, muniṃ ahaṃ sakka yathā vijaññaṃ, taṃ me viyācikkha samantacakkhu.

68798.commentary: (DNa) handa viyāyāma byāyāmā'ti handa uyyamāma byāyamāma. (DNt) viyāyāmā'ti vissaṭṭhaṃ vīriyaṃ santāne pavattema.

examples.text: handa viyāyāma byāyāma, mā no mayaṃ parapessā ahumhā, tesaṃ duve vīriyam'ārabhiṃsu, anussaraṃ gotamasāsanāni.

68799.meaning1: effort; striving; endeavouring; activity; (comm) striving to make merit
68799.commentary: (SNPa) viyārambhā'ti vividhā puññ'ābhisaṅkhār'ādikā ārambhā. (NIDD1) viyārabbho vuccati puññ'ābhisaṅkhāro apuññ'ābhisaṅkhāro āneñj'ābhisaṅkhāro.

examples.text: anejassa vijānato, n'atthi kāci nisaṅkhati, virato so viyārabbhā, khemaṃ passati sabbadhi.
